newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO unaware of Hungary bank decision.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO unaware of Hungary bank decision.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Thursday it had not been informed it had been chosen to buy Hungary's Magyar Hitel Bank (MHB).
Sources close to the transaction earlier said ABN AMRO had been selected to take over the bank with an official announcement expected this week, possibly later today.
But ABN AMRO spokesman Theo van Dijk told Reuters: "We have not yet been informed about anything by the Hungarian authorities."
The Hungarian government is selling a 90 percent stake in MHB, Hungary's fifth largest bank, through a tender.
Dutch newspaper Algemeen Dagblad said a price of between 250 million and 350 million guilders had been mentioned for the shareholding.
Newspaper reports have suggested Austria's Creditanstalt was the other bidder for control of MHB.
Sources told Reuters the announcement would be made after a meeting of state privatisation agency APV Rt.
